data.one_liner: Manage widgets dynamically based on actual internet access.
data.what_it_does: Checks if the device has an actual connection to the internet rather than just network status. Provides a ConnectivityBuilder widget and a stream to easily handle online, offline, and checking states.
use_when: You need to verify true internet access instead of just local network connectivity
You want to dynamically render online/offline widgets using a simple builder
avoid_when: You only need local network or connection type information without pinging the internet
strengths: Exposes a Dart stream for custom logic
weaknesses: Relies on polling at regular time intervals rather than push-based native events

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive connectivity status for Wi-Fi, cellular, etc., across platforms.
